This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，The time expression should be “在古代” or “古代”; “古代的时候” is not the appropriate form here.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一看很多人：一看到很多人，“看” means to look, while “看到” means to see or notice something; the sentence describes what 神农 noticed.

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundant under the teacher's standard; 在古代 is correct.
看到 correctly replaces 看 here, but the full sentence still needs 就 in the 一……就…… structure.
